latest-tables.note: A catalog-linked database does not read equality delete files ("Row-level deletes with equality delete files aren't supported", docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/tables-iceberg-catalog-linked-database); the query fails with ProgrammingError: 091968 (0A000): Equality deletes on Iceberg tables are not supported.

views.note: A catalog-linked database syncs the remote namespaces as schemas and their Iceberg tables, not Iceberg views (docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/tables-iceberg-catalog-linked-database); the query fails with ProgrammingError: 002003 (42S02): SQL compilation error: Object 'T2027824580."view_measurement"."c8y_Temperature"' does not exist or not authorized. Your primary role COMPAT_READER or one of your secondary roles must have at least one privilege granted on TABLE T2027824580."view_measurement"."c8y_Temperature".

incremental-read.note: Snowflake has no incremental read of an Iceberg table in a catalog-linked database; the CHANGES query fails with ProgrammingError: 091947 (0A000): CHANGES clause is not supported on external tables or Iceberg tables with an external catalog integration, saw 'compat_Fixture'.
